subject: Failure of alignment and scaling of the specimens with the template at digitsurface function

messages.subject: Failure of alignment and scaling of the specimens with the template at digitsurface function
parts:
Hello Dear all,

I am novel in R and need some help regarding a miss-failure of alignment (failure of the tps algorithm??) between the template and the second specimen introduced at the digitsurface function.

I have cross checked and validated the homology of the fixed landmarks across specimens so there is no problem regarding this.


Builtemplate function seems to be properly working since I have all the semilandmarks produced evenly across the templates surface.


The problem appears at the digitsurface function where the result at the rgl window shows a failure of alignment between the template and the second specimen as the resulting semilandmarks are not scattered across the specimens surface (see picture attached).


The code I am using for the Digitsurface function is:

digitsurface(scan129, matrix_129, ptsize = 0.25, center=FALSE)


where scan129=the 2nd specimen

          matrix_129=the matrix of fixed landmarks of the specimen exported from Amira

          center=FALSE as the fixed landmarks coordinates are imported outside of R


Do you have any idea of where the problem of miss-alignment comes from??


Thank you in advance,

Natasa
